$comment: Qwen Code settings for the workshop. Copy to ~/.qwen/settings.json (user scope)
or to <project>/.qwen/settings.json (project scope, wins over user scope).
JSON has no comments, so notes live here and in docs/05-qwen-code.md.
1. env.WORKSHOP_LITELLM_KEY  -> must match LITELLM_MASTER_KEY in configs/litellm/.env
2. generationConfig.contextWindowSize -> must match the -c you gave llama.cpp.
Qwen Code otherwise GUESSES the context window from the model NAME, and a
guess that is too large makes requests fail or silently truncate.
Model ids below must match model_name entries in configs/litellm/config.yaml,
which in turn must match ids your llama-swap exposes.

openai.name: cloud-fast — use when the local model is not good enough
